headline: Pope Leo XIV's flight home from Spain was grounded so the king came to his aid
context: Leo's Iberia charter, due to take him back to Rome after a weeklong visit to Spain, was grounded by a technical problem Friday, prompting Spain's king to offer his private jet instead.
